lesson_title: Imports, files, packages, secrets, and APIs
learner_starting_state: Can write a small reusable function over structured data but has not connected modules, files, environments, secrets, and HTTP request parts.
learner_ending_state: Can import standard/local modules, explain package installation into the active environment, read JSON configuration, retrieve a secret without hardcoding it, and construct an HTTP-shaped request safely.
mastery_gate: Pass primary and fresh-transfer client-bridge forms at 10 of 10, retrieval at 4 of 4, including hidden config, missing-secret, and secret-redaction probes, then explain module-file-secret-request-response flow without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Current Foundry package/authentication/endpoint examples trace to official Microsoft sources; offline request plans, domains, data, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify package names and versions, endpoints, authentication, API shapes, roles, and runtime requirements before live use.

notes: Offline two-form client bridge. It performs no network call and stores or prints no credential.
